Name: Skip Intro
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
[b]Skip Intro[/b] lets you instantly skip the intro logos and screen transition (and optionally skip straight to the load or co-op screen). Combine with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1089]Fast Animations[/url] to get into the game even faster.

[b][color=#6aa84f]For non-English players, translations are included in the base mod. [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods#translating-the-mods]Contributions are welcome[/url]![/color][/b]


[size=6][b]Install[/b][/size][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer (even if other players don't have it).
[/list]
[*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list]

[size=6][b]How to use[/b][/size]
The mod will automatically skip to the title screen. You can optionally [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/SkipIntro#configure]edit the mod settings[/url] to skip to the load or co-op screen instead.

The mod gets you to the load screen much faster than any vanilla method:
[list]
[*]Double-click the first logo: 13 seconds.
[*]Press ESC at the first logo: 5 seconds.
[*]Skip Intro: 2 seconds.
[/list]
